root.select: SELECT T.OWNER ,T.TABLE_NAME ,CMMT.COMMENTS FROM DBA_TABLES T LEFT OUTER JOIN DBA_TAB_COMMENTS CMMT ON ( T.TABLE_NAME = CMMT.TABLE_NAME AND T.OWNER = CMMT.OWNER ) WHERE T.OWNER = :owner

SELECT T.OWNER ,T.TABLE_NAME ,CMMT.COMMENTS FROM DBA_TABLES T INNER JOIN DBA_TAB_COLS C ON ( T.TABLE_NAME = C.TABLE_NAME AND T.OWNER = C.OWNER ) LEFT OUTER JOIN DBA_COL_COMMENTS CMMT ON ( C.TABLE_NAME = CMMT.TABLE_NAME AND C.OWNER = CMMT.OWNER AND C.COLUMN_NAME = CMMT.COLUMN_NAME ) WHERE T.OWNER = :owner
